templates.notes: BRD is a different document genre (business/product doc, not internal governance/legal doc) with its own 13-section structure and OBJ/BR/RULE/UC/ACT/AC traceability ID scheme, owned by the brd-generation skill for CONTENT — brd-generation still owns BRD's content workflow and section rules, this registry entry only unifies template location/routing. Template lives alongside every other SBSI template now (templates/brd/), no longer in brd-generation's own assets/ folder. FORMAT is enforced by the SAME shared sbsi-docx-format-core engine as every other document type — BRD is not skipped or special-cased in the scripts. Its own verified typography (Times New Roman 12pt, no real outline-level headings for its 13 numbered sections) is declared explicitly in templates/brd/template_manifest.json's typography_profile/requires_real_headings fields, which the shared validate_sbsi_docx.py/normalize_ordinary_text.py read and honor — always pass --manifest templates/brd/template_manifest.json when running either script against BRD output. See brd-generation/SKILL.md's 'Relationship to sbsi-template-router' section.
